items.s: The founder of Telangana Praja Samiti was:
items.x:
Most books and keys (APPSC Group-I 2002): M. Chenna Reddy. Strictly: the TPS was formed in Feb 1969 with A. Madan Mohan as its first convener; Chenna Reddy became its president and leader (NextGen AP History Part 20 p.12; Part 8 p.28).
The Telangana Praja Samithi (1969) was led by its president Marri Chenna Reddy (symbol: spade); its first convener was A. Madan Mohan. KCR founded the TRS only in 2001, and T. Anjaiah was a later CM.

items.s: Which of the following territories of the existing State of Andhra Pradesh of 2014 was NOT included in the state of Telangana?
items.x: Palnadu (Guntur region) is in Andhra Pradesh; Adilabad, Warangal and Nalgonda went to Telangana in 2014.

items.src: APPSC Assistant Tribal Welfare Officer Paper-III (Indian Con
items.s: Which key recommendation was made by the Sri Krishna Committee regarding the issue of state reorganization?
o: Division of Andhra Pradesh to form Telangana.
Formation of a separate state for tribal welfare.
Central government control over state policies.
Strengthening regional partiesinfluence at the national level.
items.x:
Most keys: bifurcation to form Telangana. Strictly the Srikrishna Committee preferred a united AP with a Telangana Regional Council and ranked bifurcation second (general knowledge, not checked).
Of the given options only division of AP to form Telangana relates to the Srikrishna Committee (2010); it actually set out six options, rating a united AP with a statutory Telangana Regional Council best and bifurcation second.

items.s: In which year was the Telangana state separated from Andhra Pradesh?
items.x: Telangana was separated from AP on 2 June 2014 under the AP Reorganisation Act 2014.

items.s: The founder of Telangana Praja Samiti was:
items.x: Marri Chenna Reddy headed the Telangana Praja Samithi (1969) as its president; Madan Mohan was its first convener (not an option).

items.s: Kalamkari in the form of painting base is practiced by artisans at?
items.x: Kalamkari has two styles: the Srikalahasti style is free-hand painting with a pen (kalam), while the Machilipatnam-Pedana style uses block printing. 'Painting base' therefore means Srikalahasti.

items.src: APPSC Junior Assistant cum Computer Assistant in ANGRAU Gene
items.s:
Consider the following pairs (Art Forms - Corresponding States).

a. Hozagiri - Tripura

b. Sirmouri Natti - Rajasthan

c. Chakri - Himachal Pradesh

d. Chandi Shilli - Sikkim
Which of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
items.x: Hozagiri is a Reang dance of Tripura (a correct); Sirmauri Nati belongs to Himachal Pradesh, not Rajasthan (b wrong), and Chakri is a Rajasthan dance, not Himachal (c wrong) – so only a and d remain.
